```{css, echo=FALSE}
body      { background-color: #1a1a2e; color: #e0e0e0; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; }
h1, h2, h3 { color: #60a5fa; }
.section-label { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 13px; }
.value-row { display: flex; gap: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; }

  background: #13131f; border: 1px solid #2a2a3e; border-radius: 8px;

}

.kpi-value { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 4px; }

.neg { color: #ef4444; }
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.retina = 2)

library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
library(scales)
```

```{r data, include=FALSE}
# ── Load universe & data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!exists("project_tree")) source(here("project_tree.R"))
if (!exists("etf_metadata")) source(here(project_tree$scripts$init))

raw_data       <- read_rds(here(project_tree$products$raw_p_d))
tech_summary   <- read_rds(here(project_tree$products$tech_summary))
outlier_report <- read_rds(here(project_tree$products$ref_report))

today     <- Sys.Date()
ytd_start <- as.Date(paste0(year(today), "-01-01"))
mtd_start <- floor_date(today, "month")
w52_start <- today - 365

perf_data <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  summarise(
    latest_price = last(adjusted),
    latest_date  = last(date),
    price_ytd    = first(adjusted[date >= ytd_start]),
    price_mtd    = first(adjusted[date >= mtd_start]),
    low_52w      = min(adjusted[date >= w52_start], na.rm = TRUE),
    high_52w     = max(adjusted[date >= w52_start], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ytd_ret   = (latest_price / price_ytd) - 1,
    mtd_ret   = (latest_price / price_mtd) - 1,
    range_pct = pmin(pmax((latest_price - low_52w) / (high_52w - low_52w), 0), 1)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    etf_metadata %>% select(ticker, name, asset_class, pf_function, tree_level, sub_block),
    by = c("symbol" = "ticker")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tech_summary %>% select(ticker, trend_regime, momentum_status, ma200),
    by = c("symbol" = "ticker")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    outlier_report %>% select(ticker, label),
    by = c("symbol" = "ticker")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ytd_ret), pf_function != "Signal")

# ── KPIs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
spy      <- perf_data %>% filter(symbol == "SPY")
spy_ytd  <- spy$ytd_ret
spy_mtd  <- spy$mtd_ret

n_bullish <- sum(perf_data$trend_regime == "Bullish", na.rm = TRUE)
n_total   <- nrow(perf_data)

fmt_pct <- function(x) sprintf("%+.1f%%", x * 100)
sign_cls <- function(x) if (x >= 0) "pos" else "neg"
```

## Market Snapshot

```{r kpis, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf('
<div class="value-row">
  <div class="kpi-box">
    <div class="kpi-title">SPY YTD</div>
    <div class="kpi-value %s">%s</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi-box">
    <div class="kpi-title">SPY MTD</div>
    <div class="kpi-value %s">%s</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi-box">
    <div class="kpi-title">Bullish Breadth</div>
    <div class="kpi-value" style="color:#60a5fa;">%d / %d</div>
  </div>
</div>',
  sign_cls(spy_ytd), fmt_pct(spy_ytd),
  sign_cls(spy_mtd), fmt_pct(spy_mtd),
  n_bullish, n_total
))
```

## 52-Week Range by Asset Class

```{r range_plots, fig.height=7, fig.width=11}
regime_colors <- c(
  "Bullish"            = "#22c55e",
  "Bullish-Correction" = "#f59e0b",
  "Bearish-Relief"     = "#f97316",
  "Bearish"            = "#ef4444"
)

plot_data <- perf_data %>%
  mutate(
    label_ytd = fmt_pct(ytd_ret),
    regime_col = coalesce(regime_colors[trend_regime], "#94a3b8"),
    ticker_label = paste0(symbol, "\n", str_trunc(name, 22))
  ) %>%
  arrange(asset_class, desc(range_pct))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(y = reorder(ticker_label, range_pct))) +

  # track
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = 1, yend = ticker_label),
               color = "#2a2a3e", linewidth = 3, lineend = "round") +

  # filled bar
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = range_pct, yend = ticker_label,
                   color = trend_regime),
               linewidth = 3, lineend = "round") +

  # current position dot
  geom_point(aes(x = range_pct, color = trend_regime), size = 3.5) +

  # YTD label on right
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.03, label = label_ytd,
                color = ifelse(ytd_ret >= 0, "#22c55e", "#ef4444")),
            hjust = 0, size = 2.8, fontface = "bold") +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.14),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
    labels = c("52W Low", "25%", "50%", "75%", "52W High")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = regime_colors, na.value = "#94a3b8") +

  facet_wrap(~ asset_class, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +

  labs(
    title   = paste("52-Week Range Position —", format(today, "%b %d, %Y")),
    subtitle = "Bar = position within 52W range | Right label = YTD return | Color = trend regime",
    x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Regime"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e", color = NA),
    panel.background   = element_rect(fill = "#13131f", color = NA),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#0f0f1e", color = NA),
    strip.text         = element_text(color = "#94a3b8", face = "bold", size = 9),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(color = "#cbd5e1", size = 7.5, lineheight = 1.2),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(color = "#888", size = 8),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#2a2a3e", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    legend.background  = element_rect(fill = "#13131f", color = NA),
    legend.text        = element_text(color = "#e0e0e0", size = 9),
    legend.title       = element_text(color = "#aaa", size = 9),
    plot.title         = element_text(color = "#60a5fa", face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(color = "#888", size = 9),
    plot.margin        = margin(12, 16, 12, 12)
  )
```

## Performance Table

```{r perf_table}
tbl_data <- perf_data %>%
  arrange(desc(ytd_ret)) %>%
  transmute(
    Ticker        = symbol,
    Name          = name,
    `Asset Class` = asset_class,
    Function      = pf_function,
    Price         = latest_price,
    YTD           = ytd_ret,
    MTD           = mtd_ret,
    `52W Low`     = low_52w,
    `52W High`    = high_52w,
    `52W Pos`     = range_pct,
    Regime        = trend_regime,
    Sigma         = label
  )

reactable(
  tbl_data,
  searchable      = TRUE,
  sortable        = TRUE,
  highlight       = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 60,
  theme = reactableTheme(
    backgroundColor = "#1a1a2e",
    color           = "#e0e0e0",
    borderColor     = "#2a2a3e",
    highlightColor  = "#252538",
    headerStyle     = list(backgroundColor = "#13131f", color = "#aaa",
                           borderBottom = "1px solid #333"),
    rowStyle        = list(borderBottom = "1px solid #22223a")
  ),
  columns = list(

    Ticker = colDef(
      width = 70,
      style = list(fontWeight = "bold", color = "#60a5fa")
    ),

    Name = colDef(
      width = 210,
      style = list(color = "#cbd5e1", fontSize = "12px")
    ),

    `Asset Class` = colDef(width = 110, style = list(color = "#94a3b8", fontSize = "12px")),
    Function      = colDef(width = 120, style = list(color = "#94a3b8", fontSize = "12px")),

    Price = colDef(
      width  = 75,
      format = colFormat(prefix = "$", digits = 2)
    ),

    YTD = colDef(
      width  = 80,
      name   = "YTD %",
      format = colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 1),
      style  = function(value) {
        list(color = if (value >= 0) "#22c55e" else "#ef4444", fontWeight = "bold")
      }
    ),

    MTD = colDef(
      width  = 80,
      name   = "MTD %",
      format = colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 1),
      style  = function(value) {
        list(color = if (value >= 0) "#22c55e" else "#ef4444", fontWeight = "bold")
      }
    ),

    `52W Low`  = colDef(width = 75, format = colFormat(prefix = "$", digits = 2),
                        style = list(color = "#94a3b8", fontSize = "12px")),
    `52W High` = colDef(width = 75, format = colFormat(prefix = "$", digits = 2),
                        style = list(color = "#94a3b8", fontSize = "12px")),

    `52W Pos` = colDef(
      name  = "52W Range",
      width = 140,
      cell  = function(value) {
        pct   <- round(value * 100)
        color <- if (value >= 0.7) "#22c55e" else if (value <= 0.3) "#ef4444" else "#3b82f6"
        htmltools::div(
          style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;",
          htmltools::div(
            style = "flex:1; background:#2a2a3e; border-radius:3px; height:10px;",
            htmltools::div(style = paste0(
              "background:", color, "; width:", pct, "%; height:10px;",
              "border-radius:3px;"
            ))
          ),
          htmltools::span(style = "font-size:11px; color:#888; min-width:30px;",
                          paste0(pct, "%"))
        )
      }
    ),

    Regime = colDef(
      width = 140,
      style = function(value) {
        color <- switch(value %||% "",
          "Bullish"            = "#22c55e",
          "Bearish"            = "#ef4444",
          "Bullish-Correction" = "#f59e0b",
          "Bearish-Relief"     = "#f97316",
          "#94a3b8"
        )
        list(color = color, fontWeight = "600", fontSize = "12px")
      }
    ),

    Sigma = colDef(
      width = 130,
      style = function(value) {
        color <- if (grepl("EXHAUSTION", value %||% "")) "#f59e0b" else "#555"
        list(color = color, fontSize = "11px")
      }
    )
  )
)
```
